questions.prompt: How do you start a single-line comment in C#?
questions.explanation: Single-line comments begin with // and continue to the end of the line.

questions.prompt: Which symbols are used for a multi-line (block) comment?
questions.explanation: Block comments are enclosed between /* and */ and can span multiple lines.

questions.prompt: Fill in the blank to start a single-line comment
What is the purpose of /// comments?
questions.explanation: /// comments produce XML documentation that tools like IntelliSense can display.

questions.prompt: Add a single-line comment that says 'debug' and still print Done
Are comments executed by the compiler?
questions.explanation: Comments are completely ignored by the compiler and do not affect execution.

questions.prompt: Arrange the lines of a multi-line comment
questions.explanation: Open with /*, write the content, then close with */.

questions.prompt: Which XML doc tag describes a method parameter?
questions.explanation: <param name="x"> documents a method parameter. <returns> documents the return value.

questions.prompt: Fill in the blank to start an XML documentation comment
What is a common use of comments?
options: Explaining code logic and leaving notes
questions.explanation: Comments explain why code exists, leave TODOs, and improve maintainability.
